description: Test whether nspC operon expression tracks a ribosomal-protein growth-rate proxy rather than any specific stress
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests

d2=pd.read_csv("https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE322nnn/GSE322955/suppl/GSE322955_PP_log_tpm.csv.gz",
               compression="gzip",index_col=0)

# growth-rate proxy: ribosomal protein operon PP_0449-PP_0470 region + rrn-proximal r-proteins
S=requests.Session()
txt=S.get("https://rest.kegg.jp/list/ppu",timeout=60).text
ann={}
for line in txt.strip().split("\n"):
    f=line.split("\t")
    if len(f)>1: ann[f[0].replace("ppu:","")]=f[-1]
rib=[g for g,d in ann.items() if ("ribosomal protein" in d.lower()) and g in d2.index]
print("ribosomal protein genes found:",len(rib))
proxy=d2.loc[rib].mean()

for g,lab in [("PP_2929","nspC"),("PP_2928","PP_2928"),("PP_1989","asd"),("PP_0567","speA"),("PP_0864","speC")]:
    r,p=stats.pearsonr(d2.loc[g],proxy)
    print(f"{lab:10s} vs ribosomal-protein mean: r={r:+.3f}  p={p:.2e}")

# partial: does nspC-PP_2928 correlation survive removing the growth-rate axis?
def resid(y,x):
    b,a=np.polyfit(x,y,1); return y-(b*x+a)
r_part,p_part=stats.pearsonr(resid(d2.loc["PP_2929"].values,proxy.values),
                             resid(d2.loc["PP_2928"].values,proxy.values))
print(f"\nnspC vs PP_2928 partial correlation controlling for growth proxy: r={r_part:+.3f} p={p_part:.2e}")

allr=d2.apply(lambda row: np.corrcoef(row,proxy)[0,1] if row.std()>0 else np.nan,axis=1)
print(f"nspC percentile of correlation with growth proxy: {100*(allr<allr['PP_2929']).mean():.1f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(10.5,4.4))
ax[0].scatter(proxy,d2.loc["PP_2929"],s=45,color="#2a6f97",edgecolor="white")
m,b=np.polyfit(proxy,d2.loc["PP_2929"],1); xs=np.linspace(proxy.min(),proxy.max(),10)
ax[0].plot(xs,m*xs+b,color="#c44536",lw=1.5)
rr,pp=stats.pearsonr(d2.loc["PP_2929"],proxy)
ax[0].set_xlabel(f"mean log TPM of {len(rib)} ribosomal protein genes")
ax[0].set_ylabel("nspC log TPM")
ax[0].set_title(f"A  nspC tracks the growth-rate proxy\nr = {rr:.3f}, p = {pp:.1e}",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax[1].hist(allr.dropna(),bins=60,color="#9a9a9a")
ax[1].axvline(allr["PP_2929"],color="#2a6f97",lw=2); ax[1].axvline(allr["PP_2928"],color="#6aa84f",lw=2)
ax[1].set_xlabel("Pearson r with ribosomal-protein mean"); ax[1].set_ylabel("genes")
ax[1].set_title("B  Genome-wide distribution\nblue nspC, green PP_2928",fontsize=10,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
